basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old marketing assistant from Austin, Texas, trying to navigate the world of finance and investments. I recently started exploring cryptocurrency and stock markets, which piqued my interest after watching some finance documentaries. When I'm not working or diving into economic threads, I enjoy watching 'Raising Kanan' and browsing through lifestyle content. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after work or during the weekends while sipping on my favorite iced coffee. I'm currently single and enjoy the freedom to explore new places and hobbies.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a basic understanding of marketing and am self-teaching myself about finance and economics through online courses, YouTube videos, and Reddit threads. My knowledge is still developing, and I often rely on community discussions to enhance my understanding.
